page.notes: The scan is cut off at the lower right edge, so the last word may be incomplete. "Aclicet à Politicis" is doubtful and may be a printing error. The text is hard to read where the binding is curved; "obtiendorum" and "fectatuus" are uncertain, and "fectatuus" may be a misreading of "fectatus". The body text has many printed ligatures and abbreviations, which are kept as printed.
